messages.content: You are a seasoned startup evaluator. Return only valid JSON with keys: Originality, Market Demand, Technical Feasibility, Barrier to Entry, Monetization Potential, Scalability, Regulatory & Legal Complexity, Overall. Each key must have {"score":0–100,"justification":"≤100 words"}. Be blunt, specific, and honest—no extra text.
HoloPost is a tabletop hologram frame for sending 3D video messages to friends. Requires a $399 device per household and a $7/month app subscription.

{"Originality": {"score": 52, "justification": "Fun gadget idea, but hologram frames have appeared before. The use case is narrow."}, "Market Demand": {"score": 28, "justification": "Most families won’t buy a pricey device for casual messages when phones already work well."}, "Technical Feasibility": {"score": 70, "justification": "Display and app are buildable; getting crisp 3D capture at home is tricky."}, "Barrier to Entry": {"score": 44, "justification": "Hardware is copyable; brand and content deals matter but are hard to secure."}, "Monetization Potential": {"score": 33, "justification": "High upfront price plus a subscription will slow adoption and repeat sales."}, "Scalability": {"score": 36, "justification": "Manufacturing and retail channels cap speed; support and returns add cost."}, "Regulatory & Legal Complexity": {"score": 90, "justification": "Low. Standard hardware certifications and privacy basics."}, "Overall": {"score": 37, "justification": "HoloPost is unlikely to succeed as is. The concept faces limited differentiation and strong incumbents and acquisition costs and weak adoption. Unless you uncover a sharp wedge and deliver friendly POS handoff that people truly prefer, consider a pivot or major redesign."}}
